name: System Audit & Analytical Evaluation Contract
description: Master prompt structure for architectural audits, security reviews, and technical assessments.

required_sections.heading: Role & Analytical Persona
required_sections.description: Principal auditor / technical evaluation specialist persona.

required_sections.heading: Audit Objective & Evaluation Scope
required_sections.description: Target systems, standards benchmarks, and assessment goals.

required_sections.heading: Evaluation Dimensions & Inspection Topology
required_sections.description: Inspection criteria, threat vectors, telemetry audits, and data models.

required_sections.heading: Verifiable Acceptance Criteria
required_sections.description: Evidence requirements, vulnerability severity thresholds, and compliance checks.

required_sections.heading: Output Format Specification
required_sections.description: Structured findings matrix with risk severity ratings and mitigations.

required_sections.heading: Analytical Self-Verification Checklist
required_sections.description: Verification of false positive filtering and reproducible proofs.

required_sections.heading: Evaluation Guardrails & Negative Constraints
required_sections.description: Prohibits subjective speculation without observable evidence or metrics.

required_sections.heading: Documented Audit Assumptions
required_sections.description: Access boundaries, test environment conditions, and compliance frameworks.
